meta.notes: Special celestial observances (solstices, equinoxes, eclipse windows, and notable sky events).

holidays.name: Earth Perihelion
holidays.description: Earth reaches its closest orbital point to the Sun.

holidays.name: Imbolc Cross-Quarter
holidays.description: Seasonal threshold between winter solstice and spring equinox.

holidays.name: March Equinox
holidays.description: Equal day and night; marks spring in the north and autumn in the south.

holidays.name: Spring Eclipse Window
holidays.description: Typical annual window for paired solar/lunar eclipses near nodal alignments.

holidays.name: Beltane Cross-Quarter
holidays.description: Fertility and fire threshold between equinox and solstice.

holidays.name: June Solstice
holidays.description: Longest day in the northern hemisphere; shortest in the southern hemisphere.

holidays.name: Sirius Rising Window
holidays.description: Heliacal rising period of Sirius in many northern latitudes.

holidays.name: Lughnasadh Cross-Quarter
holidays.description: Harvest threshold between solstice and equinox.

holidays.name: September Equinox
holidays.description: Equal day and night; marks autumn in the north and spring in the south.

holidays.name: Autumn Eclipse Window
holidays.description: Typical annual window for eclipse pairings near opposite nodal season.

holidays.name: Samhain Cross-Quarter
holidays.description: Threshold of deep autumn and ancestral observance in many traditions.

holidays.name: Leonids Meteor Peak
holidays.description: Peak of the Leonids meteor shower under dark skies.

holidays.name: December Solstice
holidays.description: Shortest day in the northern hemisphere; longest in the southern hemisphere.

holidays.name: Geminids Meteor Peak
holidays.description: Peak activity of the Geminids meteor shower.
